about: Terrace is a city in northwestern British Columbia on the Skeena River, in the Coast Mountains inland from Prince Rupert. Salmon fishing, rainforest valleys, and a role as a service hub for the northwest and Highway 16 Yellowhead corridor define the community. About 12,000 people live in Terrace.
seoSummary: Northwest B.C. Skeena River city—salmon country, rainforest valleys, and Highway 16 service hub inland from Prince Rupert.
